host.notes: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 (Zen5 mobile APU), 12 physical / 24 logical cores. Heterogeneous L3: CPUs 0-3 share 16 MiB, CPUs 4-11 share 8 MiB, so a thread set must be stated together with the domain it sits in. SMT siblings of CPUs 4-11 are 16-23; the idle gate checks them too, because a busy sibling contends with the physical core being measured.
